title: Expectation of a point indicator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p$ be a probability mass function on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$, and let $a\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The expectation under $p$ of the function that equals $1$ at $a$ and $0$ at every other point is the probability mass $p(a)$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\{-1,1\}^n$
